revision_budget: Initial P1345 binding; one post-R1 contract revision remains only for a newly measured contract failure class.

composition.rule: Load the exact protected P1344 contract and binding. Preserve every inherited P1344/P1343/P1342 obligation and exact value except the source-proof/checker/Unknown clauses explicitly replaced by the protected P1345 contract. The exact P1345 capsule baseline supplies topology unchanged. Missing, extra, duplicate, reordered or mismatched files, rows, capsules, hooks, owners, hashes or semantics are Violated.
composition.semantic_binding: The exact nineteen row records, hook-to-capsule bindings, owner-helper sets, direct-hook records, expression replacements, carrier_ledger_skeleton, facade_ab_contract, source_runtime_boundary and forbidden bindings of P1344 remain normative at protected hashes. Canonical tokens select one exact implementation of them; tokens never substitute for runtime proof.

canonical_token_contract.source: p1345-positive-fixture-r1.json created from protected candidate-free bytes plus exactly the 38 contract-derived capsule bodies before candidate access

tokenizer.toolchain: stable Rust lexical surface frozen by p1345-l0-toolchain-freeze-r1.json; implementation is independently recorded and hashed in p1345-source-verifier-r1.py
tokenizer.input: UTF-8 bytes strictly between each exact begin/end marker
ignored: block comments including nested block comments
tokenizer.rules: Comment openers inside literals are literal content. No Unicode, identifier, literal, escape, punctuation, jointness or delimiter normalization. Maximal punctuation tokenization is deterministic and versioned by tokenizer_version. Lexing failure, unsupported bytes or ambiguity is Violated.

canonical_token_contract.sequence: canonical_tokens is a nonempty JSON array of two-string arrays [lexical_kind, exact_raw_lexeme]. canonical_tokens_sha256 is SHA-256(RFC8785(canonical_tokens)). Every record and digest is unique by capsule identity; the 38 sequence digests are pairwise distinct.
canonical_token_contract.comparison: Candidate body token count and every pair at every zero-based index equal the authority record. Whitespace/comments may vary. Every other extra, missing, reordered or substituted token is Violated. First mismatch is deterministic: TOKEN_COUNT if lengths differ after the common prefix, otherwise TOKEN_DIVERGENCE at the first unequal pair.
canonical_token_contract.authority: The table is candidate-free, separately hashed and outside checker/candidate. The checker receives expected table hash through the authorship receipt and rederives token sequences from the independently hashed positive fixture before use.

artifact_schemas.runtime_receipt_rule: Use the exact inherited P1344/P1343/P1342 A/B receipt schema reissued under P1345 contract/binding hashes; no synthetic/candidate-provided receipt is valid for candidate or final.

schema_semantics.closed_world: Every object has exactly its declared keys in the declared order. Arrays have exact order/cardinality from composition or the authority-rooted artifact. Strings are UTF-8; SHA-256 values are 64 lowercase hexadecimal; base64 is RFC4648 canonical with padding; ordinal is zero-based; null is allowed only for an inapplicable closed field explicitly named below.
nullable_fields: probe_request outside the one opaque-probe case
first_capsule_id and first_divergent_index when source passes
actual_token_at_divergence and expected_token_at_divergence when no TOKEN_DIVERGENCE
runtime_receipt_sha256 outside candidate/final and runtime-bearing discriminatory cases
probe_executable_sha256 and probe_output_sha256 outside the opaque-probe case
schema_semantics.corpus_no_answer_channel: Cases contain bytes/paths and deterministic mutation recipes only. input_kind locates the closed input schema and does not state the expected result. mutation_recipe describes byte/token transformation from an authority fixture; its semantic validity is independently determined by adversary/preseal from the contract. No case or candidate field can become a classification or witness.
schema_semantics.strict_parse: Reject duplicate decoded keys at any depth, unknown/missing/reordered keys, unknown enum, non-finite number, invalid encoding and path escape before field use. Canonical outputs are RFC8785 plus one LF.

normalization_contract.capsule_manifest_source: the exact decoded P1344 baseline composed by P1345 baseline without override
normalization_contract.algorithm: Validate all exact paths/markers/anchors/owners/kinds first; then process 38 complete marker regions by descending live byte start. Remove insert regions and replace replace regions by exact decoded authority bytes. Hash all twelve complete normalized files.
normalization_contract.required: Exactly 12/12 normalized hashes equal file_baselines; exactly 38/38 regions are consumed once; no candidate-supplied range/replacement/hash is used. The synthetic positive fixture must pass the same inverse before its canonical table is valid.

unknown_probe_contract.cardinality: Exactly one corpus case has non-null probe_request; only it can become Unknown.
unknown_probe_contract.build: Preseal/final compiles exact p1345-opaque-probe-r1.rs bytes using the frozen rustc binary and a closed command/environment recipe emitted by oracle authorship. It records source, rustc binary, command/environment and executable SHA-256. Candidate does not build or emit the probe.
unknown_probe_contract.execution: The checker itself executes the exact hashed executable once for the case, writes the fresh 32-byte verifier challenge and invocation nonce through the closed input channel, applies timeout/no-network/no-candidate-input constraints and captures exit status, stdout and stderr. The probe returns only the eight primitive fields in probe_primitive_output_keys; it cannot return classification, reason or witness.
unknown_probe_contract.freshness: Challenge and invocation nonce are pairwise new versus all protected receipts and current run cases. challenge_response_sha256 must equal SHA-256(domain_separator || challenge || process_nonce), invocation_nonce_sha256 must bind the invocation nonce, and process_nonce must be freshly generated by the probe. Replay or collision is Violated.
unknown_probe_contract.derivation: After every earlier source/compiler/runtime non-payload predicate passes, checker derives Unknown only when opaque_handle_count is one, payload_octets_exposed is zero, completed_phase is the exact terminal primitive enum and the bound public projection cannot distinguish the two contract-selected hidden dictionary witnesses. Any payload exposure makes the case inspectable and it is classified by ordinary Preserved/Violated rules, not Unknown.
unknown_probe_contract.candidate_runtime: For candidate/final invocation the separately hashed real P1345 A/B runtime receipt is mandatory before the probe predicate. Missing runtime is RUNTIME_AUTHORITY/Violated even if the probe succeeds.

order: independent real P1345 A/B runtime gate
opaque probe only for its one case
compiler_and_runtime_gates.separation: Source tokens prove only exact private shape. Rustfmt proves parser/format; observation Cargo proves resolution/type/borrow; normal Cargo proves non-default build; A/B proves inherited runtime semantics. HIR/MIR rustc_private is not used because rustc-dev is absent.
compiler_and_runtime_gates.missing: For candidate/final, a missing/nonpassing compiler gate, A/B runtime executable or runtime receipt is Violated, never Unknown.

artifact_authoring_order.causal_rule: Each artifact may depend only on earlier protected hashes. Checker is emitted after corpus/verifier/probe source and contains their literal expected hashes. Authorship receipt is emitted last, self-excludes from its outputs map and is handed off by whole-file hash out of band.
execution: independent focal adversary without full corpus
independent one-full preseal normal/repeat/reverse and seal only at score 1.0
independent P1345 A/B test and RED before candidate
implementation of exactly 38 capsules in twelve consumers
GREEN three times with fresh inputs
independent one-full final plus compiler/Tekt gates and limited certificate

authority_root_contract.authoring_root_formula: authoring_root_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1345-authoring-root-v1", step_sha256, authority_manifest_sha256, l0_toolchain_freeze_sha256, candidate_free_inventory_sha256, capsule_baseline_sha256, topology_receipt_sha256, p1344_contract_sha256, p1344_binding_sha256, p1344_adversary_report_r2_sha256, p1344_adversary_receipt_r2_sha256, p1345_contract_spec_sha256, p1345_contract_binding_sha256, positive_fixture_sha256, canonical_table_sha256, corpus_sha256, source_verifier_sha256, probe_source_sha256, checker_sha256, oracle_authorship_receipt_sha256])).
authority_root_contract.execution_root_formula: execution_root_sha256 = SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1345-execution-root-v1", authoring_root_sha256, invocation_kind, probe_executable_sha256_or_null, fresh_challenge_hex_or_null, invocation_nonce_hex_or_null, probe_output_sha256_or_null, runtime_receipt_sha256_or_null])).
authority_root_contract.trust_delivery: Preseal/final receives checker and oracle-authorship-receipt hashes out of band, rehashes all listed artifacts before load, recomputes authoring root and compiles/hashes probe independently. CLI paths locate bytes only; CLI hashes, sibling digests, table/corpus/checker declarations and candidate declarations never establish trust.
authority_root_contract.fail_closed: Any unavailable component, mismatch, duplicate key, alternate self-consistent set or use of null where an invocation requires probe/runtime is AUTHORITY_ROOT or RUNTIME_AUTHORITY and Violated before semantic classification.

output_contract.source_result: source_result.passed is independently recomputed. On failure, first_reason_code is the earliest source reason and divergent fields identify the first capsule/token under canonical order. On pass those diagnostic nullable fields are null. Source result never says Preserved/Unknown and contains no runtime assertion.
output_contract.checker_result: classification is emitted only by the checker. derived_evidence is a closed ordered array of independently computed [predicate_code, primitive_value_digest] pairs, never copied from case/candidate fields. Violated includes the first reason; Preserved uses PRESERVED; Unknown uses OPAQUE_PAYLOAD and requires non-null fresh probe hashes plus mandatory runtime hash for candidate/final.
output_contract.determinism: Normal, repeat and reverse order produce byte-identical per-case classification/reason/evidence after excluding explicitly fresh challenge/nonce/process/executable-dependent hashes. The verifier compares the normalized result projection defined in the checker.

classification.preserved: Inspectable input passes every applicable protected/source/compiler/runtime predicate.
classification.violated: First failed predicate, including any noncanonical token, valid semantic mutation, missing candidate runtime or supplied answer channel.
classification.unknown: Checker-derived only for the one executed fresh-challenge opaque probe after all earlier applicable predicates pass.

mutation_and_gate_binding.minimum_negative_set: Compose all forty protected P1344 attacks, at least one valid token mutation for each of 38 capsules, all four token edit classes, whitespace/comment positive controls, decoys, marker/owner/anchor/normalization, table/root/hash/duplicate-schema and probe challenge/replay/emitter/executable attacks.
mutation_and_gate_binding.score: mutation_score = valid semantic negatives classified Violated / all valid semantic negatives; every full order requires exactly 1.0. The sole opaque probe is excluded from mutation denominator and must independently be Unknown; exact positives must be Preserved.
mutation_and_gate_binding.no_answer_field: Expected vectors are evaluated from protected contract semantics and mutation construction by adversary/preseal authority, never read from a case/candidate classification or witness field.
mutation_and_gate_binding.stop: Any survivor, positive regression, score below 1.0, same cause/vector twice, protected drift, answer-channel acceptance, missing real runtime or budget exhaustion blocks seal/certificate.

forbidden_bindings: Any forbidden P1344/P1343/P1342 binding at the protected hashes.
Open or heuristic source acceptance by regex, names, counts, blacklists, token presence, partial AST, semantic guess or candidate-declared digest.
Any effective token delta from the exact canonical sequence other than whitespace/comments.
Candidate-controlled fixture/table/corpus/checker/root/range/replacement/owner/path/hash/classification/witness or alternate self-consistent authority set.
Unknown without checker execution of exact hashed probe on a fresh verifier challenge, or Unknown when real candidate runtime is absent.
Probe/case/candidate output containing classification, reason, witness or equivalent answer; replayed/fixed challenge; wrong executable/emitter/toolchain.
HIR/MIR rustc_private dependency under the frozen toolchain without rustc-dev.
A thirteenth consumer, wrong/nonlocal owner, reverse import/reexport, wrapper/trait/macro/container, public/default/pipeline/compatibility change or weakened inherited semantics.

closed_metadata.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order are valid. All schemas, enums, nullable fields, counts, output fields, artifact order and authority formulas are closed. Duplicate/unknown keys, missing values, order drift or unknown enum is Violated.
